comparison.objective: Square a leaning carton stack in place without disassembly, versus commission a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Title implies distributed-contact pushing and stack stabilization versus recessed-tool alignment, counterholding, fine rotation, locking, and dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Only the title specifies an upright/squared intact stack; alignment, displacement, collapse, and scoring thresholds are missing. Candidate requires quantified safe stopping and retention.
comparison.reason: In-place stack correction is a different tested ability from damper commissioning, notwithstanding its missing detailed rubric.
